Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SIDBI Dy CTO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the SIDBI Deputy Chief Technology Officer (Dy CTO) position is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Dy CTO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree in engineering from Premium Institutes. An MBA is considered an added advantage for this role.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are needed for the Dy CTO position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 20 years of post-qualification experience in Information Technology is required for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Deputy Chief Technology Officer role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Deputy Chief Technology Officer post is 52 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Dy CTO position at SIDBI?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Deputy Chief Technology Officer post will receive an annual salary of Rs. 70,00,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Dy CTO recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two stages: Shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for this SIDBI job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their resume and required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Deputy Chief Technology Officer (Dy CTO) post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this SIDBI Dy CTO position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Deputy Chief Technology Officer (Dy CTO) position is Mumbai, Maharashtra.
